description: Temperature and humidity controller with two outputs and RS485 Modbus RTU: setpoints, humidity and temperature, offsets, hysteresis, output and defrost status
source: Novus N322-RHT line, register table for serial communication V2.0x (Portuguese)

sources.title: Linha N322-RHT - Tabela de Registradores para Comunicação Serial

notes: Functions 03 (read holding registers, up to 4 consecutive registers) and 06 (write single register). Writes with address 0 are broadcast; reads in broadcast are ignored.
Fixed communication: 9600 bit/s, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit. The address (1 to 247) is the Addr parameter on the controller; the manual gives no factory address.
Every register is a signed 16-bit value. Setpoints, measurements and hysteresis are read multiplied by 10 to avoid the decimal point: 253 is 25.3.
The manual does not say the unit of the temperature (a unit setting is not described in this table); °C is assumed.
A write outside the allowed range is refused with exception 03 and nothing is written.
Written from the manufacturer's document; not tested on a device.
